verses.ar:
قُلْ يَا عَظِيمْ أَنْتَ الْعَظِيمْ ۞ قَدْ هَمَّنَا هَمٌّ عَظِيمْ
وَكُلُّ هَمٍّ هَمَّنَا ۞ يَهُونُ بِاسْمِكَ يَا عَظِيمْ
verses.tr: Qul yā ʿAẓīm anta-l-ʿAẓīm · qad hammanā hammun ʿaẓīm · Wa kullu hammin hammanā · yahūnu bi-smika yā ʿAẓīm
verses.en: Say: O Tremendous One, You are the Tremendous — a tremendous worry has befallen us, yet every worry that troubles us becomes light through Your name, O Tremendous One.

verses.ar:
أَنْتَ الْقَدِيمْ قَدِيمٌ فِي الْأَزَلْ ۞ أَنْتَ اللَّطِيفْ لَطِيفٌ لَمْ تَزَلْ
عَنَّا أَزِلْ مَا قَدْ نَزَلْ ۞ مِنْ فَادِحِ الْخَطْبِ الشَّدِيدْ
verses.tr: Anta-l-Qadīm qadīmun fī-l-azal · anta-l-Laṭīf laṭīfun lam tazal · ʿAnnā azil mā qad nazal · min fādiḥi-l-khaṭbi-sh-shadīd
verses.en: You are the Eternal, eternal from before beginning; You are the Subtle, ever-subtle without cease — remove from us what has descended of crushing, severe affliction.

verses.ar:
حَيٌّ قَدِيمْ قَدِيمٌ وَاجِدُ ۞ بَاقِي غَنِيْ غَنِيٌّ مَاجِدُ
عَدْلٌ إِلَهْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدُ ۞ بَرٌّ رَؤُوفْ رَؤُوفٌ بِالْعَبِيدْ
verses.tr: Ḥayyun Qadīm qadīmun Wājidu · Bāqī Ghanī ghaniyyun Mājidu · ʿAdlun Ilāh ilāhun Wāḥidu · Barrun Ra'ūf ra'ūfun bi-l-ʿabīd
verses.en: Living, Eternal, Eternal and Perceiving; Everlasting, Rich, Rich and Glorious; Just, God, One God alone; Kind, Tender — tender with His servants.

verses.ar:
وَلِلنَّبِيِّ صَلِّ يَا سَلَامْ ۞ مِنَّا صَلَاةً مَعْ سَلَامْ
يَوْمَ الْجَزَا امْنَحْنَا سَلَامْ ۞ مِمَّا نَخَافُ يَا مَجِيدْ
verses.tr: Wa li-n-Nabiyyi ṣalli yā Salām · minnā ṣalātan maʿ salām · Yawma-l-jazā-mnaḥnā salām · mimmā nakhāfu yā Majīd
verses.en: And bless the Prophet, O Source of Peace, with blessings and peace from us — and on the Day of Recompense grant us safety from all we fear, O Glorious One.
